'''Virulli Clan''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Torani Kulda]] was a member of the clan.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
